limits: The native source has390 slots; header392 alone does not locate the two missing coordinates.
All372 observed coordinates and their relative order survive unchanged. The18 printed masks retain their identities, but five are moved.
The frame is supported by long coherent raw passages, not proved historically unique.

The word proposals have separately priced observed substitutions and half-coordinate fills. Their shared192-position reading does not combine the differing numerical evidence of the three frames; numeral values and closing identifier remain unassigned.
